expires_today.title: Akupara 10th Anniversary Bundle
expires_today.long_description:
Indie game heads likely already know and love indie studio Akupara Games, which is celebrating its 10th Anniversary this year! For the fans looking to complete their Akupara collection or those excited to meet their new favorite publisher, we have a bundle of the best of Akupara’s catalog to celebrate their birthday! Become a timid slugcat and journey through an industrial wasteland, fighting enemies with your spear in Rain World! Solve the riddles of the dungeon using the world’s mightiest weapon—words!—in Cryptmaster! Build your deck using dice instead of cards to save the Star System from ruin in Astrea: Six-Sided Oracles! There are many more fantastic Akupara games to explore in this bundle, so grab them now at the price of your choice and support Girls Make Games with your purchase!

Keys expire. Please redeem and activate on Steam before April 23rd, 2027.

expires_today.title: Dying Light 2: Stay Human Complete DLC Bundle
expires_today.long_description:
Get the most out of the vast open world of Dying Light 2: Stay Human with this bundle of Dying Light 2 DLC! In this giant collection of extras (main game not included) you’ll find tons of useful items to upgrade your journey through Villedor and beyond. The Welcome Offer: Essential Starter Kit includes a resource bundle, an XP booster, and a deadly serrated kukri! The G.R.E. Hazmat Bundle has everything you need to clean up the city while avoiding contamination! And if you’re looking for some light reading material, the Goodies Pack–Arts includes a digital artbook for the game, a digital comic, and some ready-to-print wallpapers! Enhance your experience parkouring through the wilds and wastelands of Dying Light 2 with this DLC collection, pay what you want, and support the Make-A-Wish Foundation with your purchase!

Buy Dying Light 2 Stay Human on the Humble Store to unlock this content!

Keys expire. Please redeem and activate on Steam before April 21st, 2027.

expires_today.title: Fall into Fall Fun-dle
expires_today.long_description:
It’s been a long summer, but fall has finally arrived, bringing satisfyingly crunchy leaves, pumpkin spiced drinks, and darker evenings perfect for playing this bundle of cozy games. Don your pointiest hat and enjoy the witchy vibes of potion-brewing co-op game Witchtastic and package delivery adventure game Mika and the Witch’s Mountain! Manage your own business and trade magical wares in Alchemist Shop Simulator or simply serve delicious meals to hungry customers in the Quebec-inspired Sugar Shack! There’s even more fall fun to be had in this bundle of autumnal games, so grab them now at the price of your choosing, and support Gamer’s Outreach with your purchase!

Keys expire. Please redeem and activate on Steam before April 16th, 2027.

expires_today.title: Miniatures and Mayhem: Adventures, Supplements and 3D Printables
expires_today.long_description: Embrace the chaos with an assortment of expansive campaigns and 3D printable files from Frog God Games! With adventures like Razor Coast, and The Northlands Saga Complete compatible across multiple systems, you'll be set to take your adventurers into brave new worlds. Represent all the denizens and items your table friends will encounter with high quality model files including Troll Hulk, Unicorn, Dracolich, and more. Set a new course for your next campaign, and support Oceana with your purchase.

expires_today.title: Create Magic with Magix
expires_today.long_description: Breeze through photo, musical, or video projects with professional‑quality tools by MAGIX. Unlock advanced video editing software built with precision and speed in mind with MAGIX Video Pro X16, easy music production with loops from every genre and a drag‑and‑drop workflow from Music Maker 2025 Premium, customize slideshows that turn photos into dynamic stories with Photostory deluxe 2025, and so much more! Turn bold ideas into powerful stories with the Create Magic with MAGIX Bundle, and help support Children's Miracle Network with your purchase!

expires_tomorrow.title: Gatchaman and Speed Racer by Mad Cave Studios
expires_tomorrow.description: Catch up with Speed Racer & friends!
expires_tomorrow.long_description: Dive into an all‑new interpretation of Tatsuo Yoshida’s classic manga series, Speed Racer, with our latest comics bundle! Follow the adventures of Speed, Trixie, Pops, Spritle, and Chim Chim as they race to save the day in the iconic symbol of speed and gadgetry—the Mach Five. Discover the high‑speed action of this timeless franchise! And, if that’s not enough adventure for you, we’ve included the iconic Gatchaman series for the ultimate teamup! Both legendary series are in one awesome bundle—plus, your purchase helps support the Make‑A‑Wish Foundation.

expires_tomorrow.title: Gear & Glory Action RPGs
expires_tomorrow.long_description:
Action RPGs reign supreme within the Gear & Glory Action RPGs Bundle! Text your group chat and party up for Wayfinder, the 3‑player co‑op ARPG where you customize your legendary Wayfinder hero to collect loot and slay enemies. Become the ultimate shapeshifter in Coridden, the ARPG that focuses on deadly hack‑’n’-slash combat and transformational beast powers to defeat foes and uncover tightly guarded secrets. Climb to the top of Tower of Kalemonvo, a hardcore isometric ARPG where customization is king! Collect the gear and claim your glory—plus, your purchase helps support Gold Star Gamers.

Keys expire. Please redeem and activate on Steam before April 16th, 2027.

expires_tomorrow.title: Batman Day Comics Bundle by DC Comics
expires_tomorrow.long_description:
Own the night alongside the Caped Crusader with the Batman Day Comics Bundle 2026! Pay what you want for a catalog of modern classics by the biggest Batman artists and writers like Dan Watters, Scott Snyder, and Nick Dragotta. Read the Bat's action‑packed comics, including Batman: Dark Patterns, Batman Vol. 1–10 (2011–2016), and Absolute Batman Vol. 1: The Zoo. Bring your imagination and celebrate Batman Day on September 19th with the Dark Knight’s greatest adventures, and help support the BINC Foundation with your purchase!

Redeemed on GlobalComix. Keys expire. Please redeem and activate before October 10th, 2027. Titles are not available for download off of GlobalComix.

expires_tomorrow.title: POLY Game Dev Assets Collection #3
expires_tomorrow.long_description: Game developers, build your worlds easily and efficiently with our latest POLY Game Dev Asset Collection by Animpic Studio! Pay what you want for thousands of sharp assets from professional‑quality packs like POLY - Survival Subway, POLY - Survival Tower & Builder, and POLY - Fantasy House & Builder. These Unity and Unreal Engine‑compatible packs include FBX models, prefabs, materials, shaders, and multiple scene files. Create picture‑perfect polygon‑based assets without straining your team or wallet, and help support Save the Children with your purchase!

expires_tomorrow.title: IGN 30th Anniversary Bundle
expires_tomorrow.long_description:
September is a big month for many reasons—and this September is even bigger, because we’re celebrating IGN’s 30th Anniversary! That’s right, it’s been 30 years since the very first post on IGN’s website, and to kick off the festivities we’re bringing all of you a gift: A bundle of IGN favorites to enjoy all month long, and beyond! Wage war against the dragons of Tamriel and master the art of necromancy in The Elder Scrolls Online - Elsweyr! Brave the dark reefs and deep oceans and try your best not to get eaten in Subnautica! Protect reality itself from an unknown evil in post-apocalyptic horror game REMNANT II! There’s even more fun to be had in this fantastic bundle of fan-favorite games, so grab them now at the price of your choosing and support Child’s Play with your purchase!

Keys expire. Please redeem and activate on Steam before April 9th, 2027.
